sections.title: Three steps for design planning
sections.body:
A useful design plan has three steps: collect references, sketch alternatives, then review the draft before publishing.

References give the work a starting point. Sketching alternatives makes room to compare directions before settling on one. Reviewing the draft creates a final checkpoint before it goes public.

Keeping these steps distinct can make the process easier to follow and the final review more deliberate.
